name: Founder Discovery & Narrative Development
description: Deterministic strategic operating narrative framework to uncover, validate, and translate fragmented founder insights into reusable, multi-audience strategic intelligence.
logic: Every founder has a story, but very few have a strategic narrative. Truth over hype; never sacrifice truth for persuasion. If a competitor could make the same claim, the narrative is not yet differentiated.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Initiate Workflow -> Confirm Objectives -> Gather Raw Materials -> Define Target Deliverables
Step 2: Conduct Founder Discovery -> Extract Convictions, Turning Points & Personal Mission -> Formulate Founder Profile
Step 3: Discover Strategic Insights -> Challenge Industry Assumptions -> Identify Unsolved Root Causes -> Build Insight Inventory
Step 4: Assess Founder-Market Fit -> Evaluate Domain Credibility & Unfair Access -> Audit Timing & Conviction
Step 5: Define Strategic Opportunity -> Formulate Market Shift Thesis -> Draft Opportunity Architecture
Step 6: Develop Narrative Engine -> Synthesize 16 Distinct Modular Narratives -> Build Narrative Library
Step 7: Audience Translation -> Adapt Messaging for Investors, Customers, Talent, Partners & Acquirers
Step 8: Audit & Validate -> Run 5-Level Evidence Matrix -> Verify Authenticity -> Audit 23 Required Questions
Step 9: Deliverable Generation -> Produce Pitch Decks, Executive Summaries & Messaging Repositories
Step 10: Knowledge Capture -> Commit Approved Insights to Persistent Memory -> Bind Downstream Workflows
bestPractices: Never manufacture a story; discover and validate authentic founder advantage.
Content must always precede visual design.
Require explicit human founder sign-off before triggering autonomous downstream deployment.
Flag any claim unsupported by Level 2+ evidence as an unvalidated assumption.
